samples.summary: New public /api/v1 route not recorded in rest-api.md, and an invariant stated there is now false
samples.evidence: The change adds a third v1 image endpoint, `POST /api/v1/shared/images?token=` (`ApiV1ShareImageUploadController`), registered in `api-v1.module.ts`. `docs/design/rest-api.md` is the canonical record of the v1 surface: §5.6 (lines 445–451) lists only the three workspace image routes, the controller file tree (line 585) lists only `images.controller.ts`, and line 549 asserts "Every v1 controller mounts the guard except `ApiV1ImageReadController`, which also serves anonymous share-token viewers and so cannot". The new controller mounts neither `CombinedAuthGuard` nor `WorkspaceScopeGuard`, so that sentence is now wrong, and the only place the new route is documented is `docs/design/sharing.md`. Cost is internal (the route works), but the API doc now misdescribes the guard invariant a reader would rely on.

samples.summary: `loadFileDimensions` re-implements an existing local-file measuring helper instead of reusing it
samples.evidence: `loadFileDimensions` (createObjectURL → `new Image()` → naturalWidth/Height → revokeObjectURL → reject on zero dims) is a line-for-line re-derivation of the private `loadImageDimensions(file)` in `packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/image-upload.ts:76`, which the new function's own comment points at ("Mirrors what `spreadsheet/image-upload.ts` already does"); `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/insert-image.ts` measures the same way again. The repo's stated expectation is reuse (shared helpers exported from the module that owns them — `resolveImageUrl` in that very file was exported for exactly this reason). Two copies of "measure a local image" can now disagree about the zero-dimension / revoke ordering and error wording.

samples.summary: notes.md's statement that docs share-link image upload "still fails at the backend" is contradicted by this change and was not updated
samples.evidence: `docs/design/notes/notes.md:336-337` records "the docs editor uploads through its own `docxImageUploader` path and still fails at the backend instead", and 346-349 explains the share-link limitation as "the image endpoint requires an authenticated caller". After this change docs share-link upload succeeds through `POST /api/v1/shared/images`, so the docs half of that paragraph is stale and the stated reason for the notes limitation (no share-token write route exists) is no longer the real one — the real reason is now that notes' shared mount passes no uploader, as `sharing.md` says. Nested design docs are not link/ref-checked by any lane, so nothing else will catch this.

samples.summary: The canonical two-spine image upload table was not extended with the new third route
samples.evidence: `docs/design/template-gallery.md:175-176` is a table enumerating every image upload route with its key prefix and auth model (`postSharedImage → POST /images`, bucket root, unauthenticated; `postWorkspaceImage → POST /api/v1/workspaces/:wid/images`, `{workspaceId}/{id}`, member/API key/share token). The new `postShareTokenImage → POST /api/v1/shared/images` writes into the `{workspaceId}/{id}` prefix under a *third* auth model (anonymous editor share token) and is absent, so that table no longer enumerates the upload spines it claims to.

samples.summary: Fourth hand-copied `setImageUrlResolver` seam rather than one shared implementation
samples.evidence: `setImageUrlResolver` + resolver-keyed cache now exists in four places: `packages/slides/src/view/canvas/image-cache.ts`, `packages/notes/src/view/preview.ts`, `packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/image-cache.ts`, and now `packages/docs/src/view/image-cache.ts`, each a module-level singleton with the same contract. The repo puts cross-engine shared code in `@wafflebase/core` (docs' own cache already imports `loadImage` from `@wafflebase/core/image`), so the resolver seam could have been one core-owned helper the four caches install. Behaviourally identical today; the cost is a contract ("idempotent, leave non-workspace URLs alone") maintained in four comments instead of one place, and `IMAGE_RESOLVER_INSTALLERS` needing a per-engine entry.
searchedFor: grep setImageUrlResolver across packages and docs

samples.summary: "both upload routes" comment in ImageService is now three routes
samples.evidence: `ImageService.upload`'s comment says the unsupported-type message is "Shared with both upload routes' `fileFilter`"; `image.constants.spec.ts:29` likewise says "Two upload routes' `fileFilter`s". `ApiV1ShareImageUploadController` adds a third `fileFilter` using the same constants, so both comments undercount. Harmless, but the source-scanning spec is precisely the guard those comments describe.
